title: Lockstep simulation with a complete history
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be an input word, let $c_0$ be any configuration of $M$ on $x$, and let $t$ be a natural number. After $t$ steps, the logging machine started from the logged configuration of $c_0$ with empty history is exactly the logged configuration of the source machine's configuration after $t$ steps, together with the history recorded during those $t$ steps.
replaced:
For every finite machine $M$, start configuration $c_0$ (possibly prepared, not
necessarily initial), and time $t$: running the logging machine of $M$ for $t$
steps from the logged configuration of $c_0$ with empty history yields the logged
configuration of $M$'s time-$t$ configuration together with the history of the
first $t$ steps. In particular the source's input, output, and halting time are
unchanged by the instrumentation.
